description: Fat Bikes have come a long way since we developed the world's first production aluminum fat bike in 2009. But one thing has remained constant, 9:ZERO:7 has been on the forefront in fat bike technology from the beginning. The NEW 2019 9:ZERO:7 Tundra is a perfect example of that. Taking the race proven geometry from our carbon Lynx, but using aluminum tubing, we are able to deliver winning performance in a more budget friendly package. The slack 69 degree head tube combined with the shorter 450mm chainstays keeps the handling quick yet maintains the low speed stability that 9:ZERO:7 is known for. In addition to the geometry updates, the Tundra gets stealth dropper post cable routing to further improve its aggressive terrain capabilities. Whether its racing the Iditarod Trail, surviving the Skeleton Coast in Namibia, or shredding local singletrack, the 9:ZERO:7 Tundra is truly a bike for #AllConditions.
